failure_reason: Site is a live, actively-trading relaunched MADE.com storefront (UK) - confirmed real inventory, prices, and copyright 2026; the original retailer's 2022 administration/relaunch does not affect current access. robots.txt (User-agent: *) does not block generic crawlers or name any Anthropic/Claude bot, so all three access tiers were permitted. Tier (a) direct HTTP (requests, browser-impersonating headers, warmed session cookies + Referer) got 403 Access Denied (Akamai/AkamaiGHost bot-manager challenge, bm_s/bm_so/_abck cookies) on every /shop/* category URL while the homepage / itself returned 200 - confirmed the block is specific to category-listing pages. Tier (b) headed Playwright with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled reproduced the identical Akamai Access Denied page on /shop/bedroom. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (real user Chrome tab) got past the wall once real mouse-driven link clicks were used to reach /shop/* pages (referrer-bearing navigation, not raw URL entry) - the full mega-menu tree was read and 14 leaf/subcategory quantities were captured this way. Partway through collecting the remaining 5 leaf quantities (All Curtains, All Towels, All Throws, Cotton Cushions, Velvet Cushions - all already confirmed as genuine nav nodes with real URLs), the Claude-in-Chrome extension disconnected ("Browser extension is not connected") and did not reconnect after ~5 minutes of retries. Per the first-block-stops-you rule this was not retried further; those 5 rows are recorded with qty=null and a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than fabricated.
notes: ACCESS: tier (a) HTTP blocked (Akamai 403 on all /shop/* paths); tier (b) headed Playwright blocked identically; tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome succeeded via real link-click navigation (direct URL entry to /shop/* also failed in tier (c) until a session was warmed by an actual click-through). TREE: union of the full 'Soft Furnishings' and 'Home Accessories' mega-menu columns read via get_page_text/find on the homepage (menu text captured twice, consistent) plus each category page's own breadcrumb/h1 to confirm node match - no separate XML sitemap available (sitemap.xml/sitemap_index.xml both 404). QTY: taken from each listing page's own header count in parentheses next to the H1 (e.g. 'Bed Sets (60)'), verified against the page title/breadcrumb for every row that has a qty. EXCLUDED: 'All Bedding' (/shop/bedding, 136 items), 'All Rugs' (/shop/rugs-runners-doormats), and 'All Cushions' (/shop/cushions-and-throws/cushions) parent-listing pages dropped per parent-URL-suppression rule since each has valid site-nav subcategories (Bed Sets/Bed Sheets/Duvets/Duvet Covers/Pillow cases/by-size for Bedding; Short/Carve/Flat-weave pile for Rugs; Cotton/Velvet for Cushions). Kitchen 'Bins' (/shop/kitchen/bins) excluded - these are kitchen waste bins, not storage/organization products. Furniture nodes (Sofas, Beds, Wardrobes, Chest of Drawers, Bedside Tables, Shelves, Sideboards, TV units, Bookcases, Dressing Tables, etc.), Lighting, Kitchen/Dining tableware (Dinnerware, Kitchenware, Kitchen Appliances), Home Decor (Vases, Candle Holders, Wall Art, Clocks, Mirrors, Wallpaper), Garden Furniture, and brand/swatch/colour filter nodes are all out of scope for Textile/Storage and were not recorded, consistent with Furniture.xlsx etc. already covering those categories. Storage: only one genuine Storage node found on the entire site - 'Laundry & Utility Storage' (/shop/utility-and-laundry, qty 5 - Joseph Joseph laundry separation baskets/hampers), matching storage.md Sec 11 Laundry Storage; no storage boxes/baskets/organizers/shelving nodes exist anywhere else in the mega-menu. 5 Textile leaf rows (Curtains, Towels, Throws, Cotton Cushions, Velvet Cushions) have confirmed real category URLs from the mega-menu but qty=null + MANUAL REVIEW flag because the Chrome session disconnected before their listing pages could be loaded (see failure_reason).
